notes.title: Patch 1.4 is live!
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders,

A new patch has been released today, fixing several issues in the Mortal Realms.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
Fixed a widespread crash issue related to Overwatch abilities
Fixed a common issue that resulted in players being kicked from the server
Fixed an issue that would disconnect both players when multiple Banshee died

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
Re-balanced Divine Purpose by removing the Tireless buff as well as reduced damage bonus
Re-balanced Dispel to remove multiple de-buffs at once

[h3]Technical[/h3]
Fixed a gameplay issue where units health was inaccurately displayed during AI turns
Addressed an issue where controllers would lose focus in Warband Editor
Fixed an issue where the animations for the Winged Nightmare would not play
Addressed instances of untranslated text
Addressed some UI overlap issues

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/db1ddc3a7025f6399964f6bf48f6a272af9ffea2.gif[/img]

Thank you all for your very valuable feedback and support!

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is live!
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Commanders![/h3]

First and foremost we want everyone to know that we’ve been listening to your feedback and are taking a number of significant steps to make changes to improve the experience. Our last two patches have been focused on stability improvements, but this patch has a lot of significant feature updates for you to dive into. Most notably, [b]we have a lot of balance changes, UI Improvements[/b] and changes to the campaign/multiplayer modes. We also implemented ultrawide monitor support

[b]We have a very long list of changes for this patch note and we encourage you to check out [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/topic/61364/patch-1-3-is-live]the extended patch note on our official forum[/url].[/b] We wanted to explain and detail our balance changes and the reason which led us to making these changes.

Once again, thank you for your feedback and we hope you will enjoy the changes!

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unit Editor has been redesigned to combine Wargear and Skills. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/1dd30b1a8584525e7acf5efbc0abf001ff62e36d.jpg[/img]
[*] You can now rotate a unit in the Unit Editor.
[*] Implemented larger “unit action remaining” markers.
[*] Controller Cursor no longer snaps to the hex center.
[/list]
[h3]Campaign Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Campaign starting warbands have +1 unit available per difficulty.
[*] Two new encounter types: Survive and Protect.
[*] Added a dialog skip button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/5901eb2ceaf6fde15e41ac7aa2019699d98029cc.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two new maps added to the rotation: The Lower Bole and Drowned Man’s Journey.
[i]The Lower Bole[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/ee50bb22eafd9ceae9a862ecbf65b84b2479ba8a.jpg[/img]
[i]Drowned Man’s Journey[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/a39225aa6ca7965ee3de77f8168d62189d4e1a82.jpg[/img]
[*] Fungal Cliffs map now has a new layout.
[*] Added a Tutorial to Multiplayer.
[*] Increased Earned Experience for all players.
[*] Added XP rewards to players who lost in turns 1, 2, and 3.
[*] Added a turn timer. You will now get visual and audio warnings when your turn has 30 seconds remaining. 
[*] Multiplayer Faction Progression now includes more random items than before.
[/list]
[h3]PC System/Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ultrawide Support: In game maps now have a custom camera supporting 21:9 resolutions. Front-end screens will remain centered in a 16:9 resolution.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/b6a05f898cadd1458be04ca7dd25ff4a4cdb7aee.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Audio Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of units talking over each other.
[*] Fixed over 60 bugs related to missing and broken SFX. 
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[b]Maggotkin of Nurgle[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrosion and Poison now last 2 turns by default.
[*] Disease ignores armour but only lasts 2 turns instead of 3.
[*] Blightkings base health increased from 5 to 6 and base Armour increased from 0 to 1.
[*] Rotbringers now have reduced base damage, from 3 to 2.
[*] Transmit Disease now requires you to not have moved before activating.
[*] Corruption now has a cast range of 4 increased from 2, and a reduced cooldown by 1.
[*] Feculent Gnarlmaw - Base aethyr cost reduced from 4 to 3 and base cast range increased from 3 to 4.
[*] Nurglings - Seed of Corruption has been moved to an off-hand ability and they have disease bomb by default.
[*] Calcify now has an increased cooldown from 2 to 3.
[*] Replaced Second Nature property with Tireless, so while you can still charge after using, you can't use other abilities.
[*] Debilitating Aura now leaves a lingering debuff for 1 turn that is refreshed every turn
[*] Great Corruptor now applies the effects of adjacent corruption whenever you take ANY damage instead.
[*] Fixed Corrosive items dealing too much / inconsistent damage when more units were involved.
[*] Fixed Layer of Sick (+1 armour when using Joyous bile) only lasting until end of turn.
[/list]
[b]Nighthaunt[/b]
[list]
[*] Overrun can only be activated once per turn.
[*] If you have a 2nd skill of Overrun it will grant the Fall Back passive after Overrun has been triggered.
[*] Fall Back - Dealing any damage will refresh the unit with Relentless (allowing them to move and use abilities again), but they will deal 0 damage with ALL abilities, but Into the Mist has 0 Aethyr cost. 
[*] Arcane Claw’s range is lowered from 5 to 3 
[*] Lady of Ashes will now be healed when she retaliates in melee with Healing Winds
[*] Myrmourn Banshees - Increased base summons from 1to 2 in multiplayer .
[*] Ethereal now ignores taking/dealing damage from basic ranged attacks.
[*] Summoning Wisps now costs 1 less Aethyr and the cooldown has been lowered by 1.
[*] Blazing Step skill (leave spectral flames on ground) now lasts 1 turn instead of just end of turn.
[*] Fixed Chainghast Solitary skill.
[*] Chainrasp Endless Horde skill can now be correctly equipped 3x.
[*] Nighthaunt weapons that say they rend armour will now work correctly.
[*] Lowered range of Chains of Burden (AOE Legendary) from 4 to 3.
[*] Enhanced Summoning Skill (Knight of Shrouds) now only grants +1 summon range to wisps instead of +2.
[/list]
[b]Stormcast Eternals[/b]
[list]
[*] Zealous skill has been separated into 2 separate cards, 1 grants -1 cooldown to main hand weapons the other grants -1 Aethyr cost to them.
[*] For each copy of Zealous you had, you will receive an extra card for -1 Aethyr (E.g. you have 3 of them, you will keep 3 for -1 cooldown and gain an additional 3 for -1 Aethyr).
[*] Tireless skill no longer grants +1 movement with a single stack. Grants+1 movement for each additional stack (e.g. if you have 3, you will get +2 movement after casting an ability).
[*] Decreased cooldown of Challenge by 1.
[*] Fixed a bug where Challenge couldn’t target ranged units that were channeling in order to interrupt them. Now if they will be interrupted but won’t attack back.
[*] High ground bonus is reduced from 2 to 1 damage.
[*] Lightning Rod is no longer buffed by stacks of Frenzy.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] When knocked into Endless Spells or Alchemic Transmutation, you take 3 bonus damage for a total of 4 that ignores armour instead of being instantly killed.
[*] By default, all traps have a cast range of 2 instead of 1.
[*] Base cost of traps except Violent Growth cost 0 Aethyr instead of 1.
[*] Many traps had their cooldowns lowered.
[*] Blitz will no longer allow you to execute 2 charges AND an ability in the same turn, regardless of order of execution.
[*] Blitz no longer allows you to execute a charge and then a damaging ability without its stack being removed. 
[*] Deflect now blocks basic ranged attacks by default
[*] Barriers no longer last forever.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could cast barriers for free when your unit had no other moves.
[*] Fixed environmental hazards escalating their damage over time.
[*] Fix for Layer of Sick (+1 armour when using Joyous bile) only lasting until end of turn
[*] Auto-dispel no longer works on Endless Spells
[*] Units can no longer pass through Grove of Renewal or Feculent Gnarlmaw.
[*] Fixed a bug where hazards like fire could deal extra damage when summoned on a unit occupying a hex containing other props. This damage didn’t preview correctly, which would have caused confusing results.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support.
See you in the Mortal Realms,

[i][b]The Gasket Games and Focus Home Interactive teams.[/b][/i]

notes.notes:
Hello Commanders!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nTpKlJu.gif[/img]

Patch 1.1 is now live! In this first update we focused on fixing progression-blocking issues as well as server crashes and timeouts in multiplayer. Our top priority is still to make sure everyone has a stable experience. We also made numerous balance changes, targeting all three factions.

Our next changes will focus on improving the Warband editor and the UI. We are also looking at further balance changes, as well as enhancements for progression in PvP. 

Keep the feedback coming! It is very valuable to us. Don’t forget that we have a [url=https://support.focus-home.com/hc/en-us/categories/360003732217-Warhammer-Age-of-Sigmar-Storm-Ground]dedicated Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground support website[/url] for common issues. You can also report your technical issue over there.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Technical issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple Server crashes and timeouts in multiplayer. 
[*] Fixed multiple crashes in practice. 	
[*] Addressed issues causing players getting kicked from MP matches. 
[*] Addressed various progression blocking issues (instances of invisible units, missing warchest rewards, missing soul prison). 
[*] Fixed multiple animation issues causing delays in action resolution.
[*] Fixed missing localisation texts.
[*] Changed multiple mission briefings in ascension 2 & 3 so they correspond to the actual mission.
[*] Fixed a bug where units with Divine Frenzy could cast it multiple times per turn. 
[/list]

[h2]Balancing updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] In multiplayer, Nurglings now come as a stack of 2. 	
[*] Chainghasts no longer have 1 armour piercing. 	
[*] Fixed several abilities that could target hexes where they would have no effect. 	
[*] Expanded valid targets for Aetheric Slam to be more useful against Corruption. 	
[*] Increased the cost of Grove of Renewal from 3 to 5 to reflect its value and duration. 	
[*] The Spread Plague ability can now be used after moving. 	
[*] The Ruinous Chill Blade can now be cast on empty tiles, allowing for more free form targeting. 	
[*] The Lady of Ashes “Burning Hatred” ability no longer triggers on fire damage (coming from herself) creating neverending stacks of fire. 
[*] Lady of Ashes now gets a default nightmare lantern if you equip her with a one handed weapon. 
[/list]
	
Thank you for your support!

Focus & Gasket team.

notes.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground review
notes.notes: With Warhammer games having the hit ratio of a blunderbuss shooting a target at fifty feet, I should really be immune to its allure by now. But by Sigmar's steely scrotum, something about its world just gets me. I'll internet-binge whichever faction I command in Total War: Warhammer, and amidst the onslaughts of Vermintide I'll tell my teammates to shut up and wait a second as I soak up the banter between the heroes in my search for little lore tidbits... notes.title: Community update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[b]First we'd like to send a warm thanks to all of you for playing![/b] We have been watching your streams, videos and comments and we are thrilled to see how many of you are loving Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground. 

[b]We are passionate Warhammer fans like you[/b] and we are aiming at making the best game possible for this beloved franchise. On behalf of all of us at Focus and Gasket Games: THANK YOU!

We've been reading and compiling feedback from everywhere and they’ll be the base of our post-launch updates. As we're working on the next patches, we wanted to give you more visibility on our top priorities for upcoming fixes.

[list]
[*] [b]PvP Timeouts[/b]: We are investigating the issue causing some players to timeout and get ejected from a game.
[*] [b]Progression Blockers[/b]: We are aware of crashes/bugs on specific encounters and wargear impeding progression. This Includes hidden units and all sorts of bugs that are preventing the mission from being completed.
[*][b]Hangouts[/b]: Some animations are causing delays in action resolution, which can slow the pace of combat. 
[/list]

[b]Ensuring everyone has a smooth experience is of course our top priority[/b]. We are continuously reading your feedback and we are prioritizing fixing game-breaking bugs. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cF0tKXb.gif[/img]

In line with this objective of having the smoothest game possible on a technical level, [b]it would be very helpful for us if you submitted the Unreal Engine crash report every time you experience a crash![/b] If you could also fill in the text box explaining the conditions in which the crash occurred, it would also be very helpful!

Thanks again for your support!

[i]Gasket & Focus Teams[/i]

notes.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground review - solid strategy
notes.notes:
Six years ago Games Workshop expanded their venerable Warhammer Fantasy Battle wargame by introducing the new, sexy Age of Sigmar. Out went the quasi-medieval Old World with its blocks of grubby foot knights, in came the multi-dimensional Mortal Realms and shiny, superhuman Stormcast Eternals. It had a warm reception - by which I mean one guy was so disgusted he set a thousand dollar model collection on fire - but six years is long enough for new blood to discover and adopt the setting.

Barring a couple of digital card games and autobattlers, Storm Ground is Age of Sigmar's first major outing in videogames - and you can buy it here, coincidentally. So, does Storm Ground land like a thunderbolt hurled from Azyr, or bubble up like a swampy fart in the rotten cauldron of Nurgle?

The Age of Sigmar is a time of ceaseless war between the many Gods and their servants. Three factions feature in this turn-based strategy game, the lightning-riding Stormcast who serve beardy, hammer-fixated Sigmar, the Maggotkin of the plague god Nurgle, and the Nighthaunt, ghostly slaves to Nagash, lord of Undeath. They're all more or less immortal - killing a Stormcast sends their soul back to the realm of Azyr to be reforged on a big magic anvil, Maggotkin go back to the loam in Nurgle's manky metaphysical compost heap, and the ghosts are kind of already immortal.

notes.title: Get your first glimpse of Warhammer game Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground in action
notes.notes:
Focus Home Interactive has shared a new video showcasing core gameplay in the publisher's upcoming Warhammer game, Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground. Storm Ground marks the first serious attempt to adapt Games Workshop's Age of Sigmar tabletop line into a videogame format, with previous attempts mainly involving free-to-play or mobile-style games.

Storm Ground is a turn-based strategy game where you can take charge of a highly customisable army from one of three factions; the not-Space Marine Stormcast Eternals, the Nighthaunt, and the Nurgle-tastic Maggotkin. Each faction has their own playstyle, for example the Stormcast are incredibly tanky, while the Nighthaunt prefer good old-fashioned swarm tactics. You can choose from several hero units within a faction to lead your force, with a diverse roster of additional unit types inspired by the tabletop game to back up your leader.

There will be a campaign mode where you can collect additional heroes, units, wargear, skills, and weapons via a card-based collection mechanic. Campaigns are non-linear and procedurally generated, and you can take your force online in multiplayer skirmishes as well. Emphasis has also been put on the game's environments, with certain tiles being key to victory.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Get a gameplay in-depth look!
notes.notes:
[h3]Our new overview trailer offers a detailed look at Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground’s strategic gameplay![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iV7QWjv.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!

We’re excited to present our dynamic, turn-based combat and our progression system in today’s trailer. You will learn more about the three unique factions of the game, and get a glimpse at the variety offered by progression and combat.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SXeOyBNUR8Q
[h3]Three factions wage all out war in spectacular and fast-paced tactical battles.[/h3]

Pick one of Storm Ground’s three factions - the stalwart Stormcast, the ghoulish Nighthaunt and the putrescent Maggotkin - and lead your highly-customisable force in this dynamic turn-based strategy game packed with fast-paced warfare. In campaign mode, upgrade your army by collecting new heroes, units, wargear, skills, weapons and more. New units will allow you to build your army your way, choosing who to field with every new battle and customizing every facet of their equipment to match your playstyle. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G27WtwB.jpg[/img]

[h3]A non-linear, replayable solo-campaign and epic multiplayer battles.[/h3]

Each non-linear, procedurally-generated campaign will be a new experience whenever you begin it, meaning an endlessly replayable single-player offering. Multiplayer has you gaining a collection over time as you win more and more battles against other players online, changing your army as you earn more rewards. 

Those battles are intense, tactical fights across a wide variety of battlefields in the realms of Life, Death, and Metal. Every hex has tactical relevance, from valuable high ground to aethyr pools brimming with energy and ancient chests filled with secrets and rewards. Use the strengths of your army to gain the upper hand, fighting on advantageous terrain and in situations where you can grasp victory.
Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground releases on May 27. Pre-order today to get a special discount and receive the Spoils of War Weapon Pack giving access to one exclusive weapon for each of the game’s three armies.

notes.title: Warhammer Age Of Sigmar: Storm Ground coming in May
notes.notes:
Across the squillion Warhammer games we get these days, we don't see much in Age Of Sigmar, the setting which semi-replaced Warhammer Fantasy Battle in 2015. Hey, look, here comes Warhammer Age Of Sigmar: Storm Ground, with a freshly-announced release date of May 27th. It's a turn-based tactical battler about building an army to duff up other wizards. A new trailer shows a little of what that looks like.

notes.title: Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground releases on May 27th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xSBHXFk.gif[/img]

[h3]We're very happy to announce that Warhammer - Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground is releasing on May 27th![/h3]

We are excited to share with you the first glimpses of our fast-paced tactical gameplay and third faction - the Maggotkin of Nurgle. Check out today’s Release Date Reveal trailer and prepare to conquer the Mortal Realms!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4BbbzH3JDQ
[h3]Fast-paced tactical battles and thousands of ways to make your army your own.
[/h3]

Storm Ground is an action-packed, turn-based strategy game where you lead one of three highly-customisable armies - the eternal Stormcasts, the ghoulish Nighthaunt and the rotting Maggotkin - to glory through conquering their enemies in roguelike single-player campaigns or defeating other players in online PvP.

Use them to best your opposition in quick-hitting matches where your every move can decide the outcome, and make your way through the Age of Sigmar’s rich and monumental realms of Life, Death and Metal.

With each new battle, unlock and collect new cards, granting you new units, skills, weapons and gear to equip them with and ever new ways to create your own playstyle with the thousands of possible combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626096/67995bc2d43eef762112619a706adf90e8bf5383.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Maggotkin of Nurgle also join the fray.
[/h3]

The newly revealed faction, the Maggotkin of Nurgle, are a tide of death riding on a behemoth’s back. The Maggotkin corrupt everything they come across, creating hazardous zones on the battlefield that they can harvest to reap a terrible reckoning on their enemies.

Warhammer - Age of Sigmar: Storm Ground releases on May 27th. Pre-order today on Steam to get 15% off and receive the Spoils of War Weapon Pack giving access to one exclusive weapon for each of the game’s three armies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233590/Warhammer_Age_of_Sigmar_Storm_Ground/
